displayName: The Platinum Card® from American Express

benefits.name: Global Lounge Collection®
benefits.shortDescription: $850+ annual value — Centurion Lounges, 10 Delta Sky Club visits, Priority Pass Select
benefits.fullDescription: Over $850 of annual value with access to Centurion Lounges, 10 complimentary Delta Sky Club visits when flying on an eligible Delta flight, Priority Pass Select membership (enrollment required), and other select partner lounges.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Priority Pass Select requires separate enrollment via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Present card (+ boarding pass where required) at Centurion Lounges; enroll in Priority Pass Select for 1,300+ partner lounges; Delta Sky Club access when flying Delta same-day.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Delta Sky Club capped at 10 visits per benefit year (Feb 1–Jan 31, tracked separately from the calendar year). Guest access to Centurion Lounges requires $75,000 in annual spend or a per-guest fee. Priority Pass Select requires separate enrollment.
benefits.notes: This is Amex's own stated estimate of value, not a redeemable statement credit. Worth flagging as a modeling simplification: this single benefit actually bundles two different patterns — Centurion/Priority Pass access (a true statusKind: 'access' concept) and 10 Delta Sky Club visits (which is really statusKind: 'usageCounter', same as Delta Reserve's own Sky Club visits benefit). Left as one 'access' entry for now rather than splitting into two catalog rows; split it if usage data shows people care about the visit count specifically.

benefits.name: Hotel Credit (Fine Hotels + Resorts® / The Hotel Collection)
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $300 semi-annually, $600/year
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits up to $300 semi-annually on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts® or The Hotel Collection bookings through Amex Travel. The Hotel Collection requires a minimum two-night stay.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book a prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection stay through American Express Travel using the Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: The Hotel Collection requires a minimum 2-night stay. Must book through Amex Travel. Statement credit up to $300 per half; does not roll over.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $200/year — $15/mo Uber Cash + $20 bonus in December
benefits.fullDescription: Add your Card to your Uber account and pay for rides or orders in the U.S. with an Amex Card to get $15 in Uber Cash monthly, plus a $20 bonus in December.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Add your Platinum Card as the payment method in the Uber app.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Uber Cash loads automatically to your Uber account on the 1st of each month; use it on U.S. Uber rides or Uber Eats orders. December includes a $20 bonus on top of the $15.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: U.S. rides/orders only. Unused monthly Uber Cash does not roll over. Must select the Platinum Card as the Uber payment method.
benefits.notes: December credit is $35 total ($15 + $20 bonus).

benefits.name: Uber One Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $120/year — covers an auto-renewing Uber One membership
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits per calendar year after you purchase an auto-renewing Uber One membership.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Purchase an auto-renewing Uber One membership with the Platinum Card.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Subscribe to Uber One and pay with the Platinum Card; the membership fee is credited back.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Separate from the monthly Uber Cash benefit; this covers the Uber One membership fee itself. Terms apply.

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $200/year for one selected airline's incidental fees
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits per calendar year for incidental fees charged by your one selected qualifying airline.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Select your one qualifying airline in the Amex benefits hub each calendar year.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Incidental fees (checked bags, seat selection, in-flight purchases — not fares) charged by your selected airline to the Platinum Card are reimbursed. Can take up to 8 weeks to post.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Airline selection is a one-time choice per calendar year and cannot be changed after selection. Does not cover ticket/fare purchases. Qualifying incidental categories subject to airline reporting accuracy.

benefits.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts® Benefits Suite
benefits.shortDescription: $550+ average value per stay — room upgrade, breakfast, late checkout, property credit
benefits.fullDescription: Unlock a complimentary suite of benefits worth an average total value of $550 per stay when you book Fine Hotels + Resorts through Amex Travel. Average value based on 2024 bookings for stays of two nights; actual value varies by property, room rate, upgrade availability, and use of benefits.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book any Fine Hotels + Resorts property through Amex Travel with the Platinum Card to unlock the complimentary benefits suite for that stay — typically room upgrade if available, daily breakfast for two, noon check-in/4pm checkout, and a property credit (often ~$100).
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Value varies by property, room rate, and upgrade availability. Not a fixed statement credit — applies per qualifying stay, with no cap on the number of qualifying stays per year. May overlap with the Hotel Credit above if the same booking qualifies for both.
benefits.notes: Track as a reference/reminder benefit rather than a $ ledger — value is per-stay and variable, unlike the fixed-dollar credits, so it doesn't fit the cycle/remaining-balance model. Give it a distinct UI treatment (info card, not a gauge).

benefits.name: CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $209/year for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits per calendar year for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ Membership, excluding taxes and fees.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership with the Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Covers the CLEAR+ membership fee specifically, excluding taxes and fees; subject to auto-renewal pricing.

benefits.name: Resy Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $100/quarter ($400/year) at U.S. Resy restaurants
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits up to $100 quarterly when you make eligible purchases at U.S. Resy restaurants.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Add your Platinum Card to your Resy profile.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Dine at participating U.S. Resy restaurants or make other eligible Resy purchases using the Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: U.S. Resy restaurants and eligible Resy purchases only. Enrollment required. Unused quarterly amount does not roll to the next quarter.

benefits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $25/mo ($300/year) on eligible digital entertainment purchases
benefits.fullDescription: Up to $25/month back on purchases including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, Peacock, Paramount+, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, YouTube Premium, and YouTube TV.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex Offers/benefits hub in the Amex app.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay for eligible purchases — Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, Peacock, Paramount+, NYT, WSJ, YouTube Premium, or YouTube TV — with your Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Limited to the named eligible partners above; list changes periodically, so re-verify before assuming a new service qualifies. Credit does not roll over month to month.

benefits.name: lululemon Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $75/quarter ($300/year) at U.S. lululemon stores and lululemon.com
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credits up to $75 quarterly for eligible purchases at U.S. lululemon retail stores (excluding outlets) and lululemon.com.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex Offers/benefits hub in the Amex app.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Shop at U.S. lululemon retail stores (excluding outlets) or lululemon.com and pay with the Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: U.S. retail stores and lululemon.com only; outlet stores excluded. Enrollment required. Unused quarterly amount does not roll over.

benefits.name: Walmart+ Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $155/year — covers one monthly Walmart+ membership
benefits.fullDescription: Statement credit for one auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership, up to $12.95 monthly plus applicable taxes.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay for an auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership with the Platinum Card; the membership fee (up to $12.95/mo) is credited back, plus applicable taxes.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Covers the monthly Walmart+ plan specifically — does not apply to the discounted annual Walmart+ plan. Applicable taxes are separate from the credited base fee.

benefits.name: Burger King Benefits (via Walmart+)
benefits.shortDescription: 25% off Burger King orders + 1 free Whopper every quarter, through Walmart+
benefits.fullDescription: Through your Walmart+ membership: 25% off Burger King orders and 1 free Whopper every quarter.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Requires an active Walmart+ membership (see Walmart+ Credit above) — no separate enrollment beyond that.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Order from Burger King through the Walmart+ benefit; 25% off applies automatically, plus one free Whopper redemption per quarter.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Contingent on active Walmart+ membership. The 25% discount has no fixed dollar cap — value scales with order size, so it's tracked as a perk, not a statement credit. The free Whopper is worth roughly $5–6 depending on location and isn't itemized as its own dollar figure here.
benefits.notes: Non-monetary/discount-based perk — no stated fixed value from Amex or Walmart, unlike the Lounge Collection or FHR Suite which at least have marketing-stated estimates. Track as a quarterly reminder ('use your free Whopper'), not a dollar ledger.

benefits.name: Oura Ring Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $200 back per calendar year on an Oura Ring purchase
benefits.fullDescription: Up to $200 back per calendar year when you purchase an Oura Ring at ouraring.com.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex Offers/benefits hub in the Amex app before purchasing.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Purchase an Oura Ring directly at ouraring.com with the Platinum Card; the credit applies automatically up to $200.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: ouraring.com purchases only. Structured as an annual credit, but realistically a one-time purchase for most cardholders — nobody buys a new Oura Ring every year, so don't expect repeat usage even though the credit technically resets.

benefits.name: Equinox Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $300 back per year on Equinox+ or an Equinox club membership
benefits.fullDescription: Up to $300 back per year on an Equinox+ digital subscription or Equinox club membership.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex Offers/benefits hub in the Amex app.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay for an Equinox+ digital subscription or an Equinox club membership with the Platinum Card; credits apply up to $300/year.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Covers either the digital subscription or a physical club membership, not necessarily both simultaneously up to separate caps — confirm against Amex's current terms whether it's a shared $300 cap or per-product.

benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book a prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection stay through Amex Travel using the Business Platinum Card.

benefits.name: Global Lounge Collection®
benefits.shortDescription: $850+ annual value — Centurion Lounges, 10 Delta Sky Club visits, Priority Pass Select
benefits.fullDescription: Complimentary access to more than 1,550 airport lounges, including Centurion Lounges, 10 Delta Sky Club visits when flying an eligible Delta flight, and Priority Pass Select membership.

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit

benefits.fullDescription: Select one qualifying airline and receive up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year when incidental fees are charged to your Business Platinum Card.

benefits.redemptionInstructions: Incidental fees (checked bags, seat selection, in-flight purchases) charged by your selected airline are reimbursed automatically.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Airline selection is a one-time choice per calendar year. Does not cover ticket/fare purchases.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $209/year for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership
benefits.fullDescription: Get up to $209 back per calendar year on your CLEAR+ membership (subject to auto-renewal).
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Covers the CLEAR+ membership fee, excluding taxes and fees.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $120 (Global Entry) or $85 (TSA PreCheck), every 4 years
benefits.fullDescription: Receive either a $120 statement credit for Global Entry or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck every four years.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: One reimbursement per 4-year cycle. Global Entry includes TSA PreCheck access.

benefits.name: Hilton for Business Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $50/quarter ($200/year) on direct Hilton purchases
benefits.fullDescription: Hilton for Business members get up to $200 back per calendar year (up to $50/quarter) on eligible purchases made directly with any Hilton portfolio property.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll in Hilton for Business via the Amex benefits hub — if your business doesn't have an account, one is created automatically upon enrollment.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book directly with a Hilton portfolio property and pay with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Gift cards are not eligible purchases. Direct Hilton bookings only. Unused quarterly amount does not roll over.
benefits.notes: Distinct from Hilton Honors Gold status below — this is a real statement credit specific to the business card, not offered on Personal Platinum.

benefits.name: Wireless Telephone Credit
benefits.shortDescription: $10/month ($120/year) on a U.S. wireless telephone bill
benefits.fullDescription: $10 in monthly statement credits (up to $120/year) toward a U.S. wireless telephone bill charged to the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Pay a U.S. wireless telephone bill with the Business Platinum Card; the $10 monthly credit applies automatically once enrolled.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: U.S. wireless carriers only. Unused monthly amount does not roll over.
benefits.notes: This one was missing from the catalog entirely until cross-checked against a user-provided source spreadsheet — not a case of an intentional exclusion like the $250k-threshold credits, just a genuine gap in the original research pass. Good case for why the periodic re-verification in §11.2 matters even when nothing seemed obviously wrong.

benefits.name: Indeed Credit
benefits.shortDescription: $90/quarter ($360/year) on Indeed hiring purchases
benefits.fullDescription: $90 in quarterly statement credits (up to $360/year) on eligible Indeed purchases made with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Purchase Indeed hiring products/sponsored job posts with the Business Platinum Card; the $90 quarterly credit applies automatically once enrolled.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Indeed purchases only. Unused quarterly amount does not roll over.
benefits.notes: Previously flagged as omitted for lack of a confirmed dollar figure ('general market commentary mentions it exists... but this search pass didn't surface a confirmed current figure'). A user-provided source spreadsheet supplied the real number ($90/quarter, $360/year) — added now that it's verified rather than guessed.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.shortDescription: Complimentary Gold Elite status, no stay requirement
benefits.fullDescription: Receive Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status without meeting any stay requirements.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Link your Marriott Bonvoy account; Gold Elite benefits (room upgrades when available, late checkout, bonus points) apply automatically at Marriott properties.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Status-based, not a statement credit — no stated dollar value.
benefits.notes: Non-monetary status benefit — track as an enrollment checklist item, same treatment as Venture X's Hertz status.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Gold Status
benefits.shortDescription: Complimentary Gold status at Hilton properties
benefits.fullDescription: Enjoy Hilton Honors Gold status benefits at hotels and resorts within the Hilton Portfolio, and earn reward stays faster with bonus points.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Link your Hilton Honors account; Gold status benefits apply automatically at Hilton properties.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Status-based, not a statement credit — no stated dollar value.
benefits.notes: Non-monetary status benefit, same treatment as the Marriott status above.

benefits.name: Dell Technologies Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $150/year on U.S. Dell purchases
benefits.fullDescription: Get back up to $150 in statement credits for U.S. Dell Technologies purchases per calendar year.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Purchase from Dell Technologies in the U.S. with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: U.S. Dell purchases only.

benefits.name: Dell Technologies Bonus Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Additional $1,000/year after $5,000 in Dell purchases
benefits.fullDescription: After spending $5,000 or more on U.S. Dell Technologies purchases in a calendar year, receive an additional $1,000 statement credit.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Same enrollment as the base Dell credit above.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Reach $5,000+ in cumulative U.S. Dell purchases on the Business Platinum Card within the calendar year; the $1,000 bonus posts automatically.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Spend-gated — requires $5,000+ in qualifying Dell purchases, separate from the $150 base credit above.
benefits.notes: Kept as a separate line item from the $150 base credit rather than merged into one $1,150 figure, since the mechanics are genuinely different: one is unconditional, the other requires hitting a real spend threshold. Merging them would overstate 'available value' for anyone who doesn't spend $5k/year with Dell.

benefits.name: Adobe Credit
benefits.shortDescription: $250/year after $600 in Adobe purchases
benefits.fullDescription: Get a $250 credit at Adobe when you spend $600 or more on Adobe products in a calendar year.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Spend $600+ on Adobe products/subscriptions with the Business Platinum Card within the calendar year; the $250 credit posts automatically.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Spend-gated at $600 — a realistic threshold for most small businesses already paying for Adobe Creative Cloud or similar.

benefits.name: ChatGPT Business Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $300/year on ChatGPT Business
benefits.fullDescription: Receive up to $300 in statement credits per calendar year on U.S. purchases of ChatGPT Business made directly with OpenAI.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll via the Amex benefits hub.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Purchase ChatGPT Business directly from OpenAI (OpenAI must be the merchant of record) with the Business Platinum Card.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Capped at $300 per Card Account per calendar year, even across the Basic Card Member and Employee Cards combined. Subject to auto-renewal.
benefits.notes: One of the newest credits on this card (added 2025) — a good early example of issuers chasing current software trends. Re-verify this one more frequently than most; it's exactly the kind of credit likely to change or get replaced.

benefits.name: Annual Travel Credit
benefits.shortDescription: $300/year, auto-applies to any travel purchase
benefits.fullDescription: Get up to $300 annually toward travel purchases — the most flexible travel credit available.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: No action needed — automatically applies as a statement credit against the first $300 of travel-category purchases (airlines, hotels, car rentals, cruises, trains, tolls, parking, campgrounds) each cardmember year.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Resets on account-opening anniversary, not calendar year. Broadest 'travel' category definition of the cards in this catalog.

benefits.name: Chase Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $100/year for hotel stays booked through Chase Travel
benefits.fullDescription: Earn up to $100 in statement credits each account anniversary year for hotel stays purchased through Chase Travel.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book any hotel stay through the Chase Travel portal with the Sapphire Reserve; credit applies automatically.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Separate from The Edit hotel credit below — this applies to general hotel bookings through Chase Travel, not just The Edit collection. Resets on account anniversary.
benefits.notes: Distinct from The Edit hotel credit — confirm with Chase whether the two can be combined on the same qualifying stay before assuming both apply.

benefits.fullDescription: Get up to $500 annually for prepaid bookings made with The Edit℠, Chase's hand-picked collection of hotels and resorts.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Book a prepaid stay of 2+ nights at a property in The Edit via Chase Travel.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Max $250 credit per individual booking, up to two bookings per calendar year ($500 total); two-night minimum per stay; credits do not combine across bookings.
benefits.notes: Restructured in Jan 2026 to remove the prior H1/H2 split — now up to two $250 credits usable any time in the calendar year.

benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Enroll and book via the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables program on OpenTable.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Dine at participating Exclusive Tables restaurants, booked through OpenTable, and pay with the Sapphire Reserve.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Restricted to the Exclusive Tables restaurant list, not all dining. Jan–Jun and Jul–Dec windows; unused amount does not roll over.

benefits.name: StubHub / viagogo Credit

benefits.fullDescription: Up to $300 in annual StubHub and viagogo statement credits, split into two semi-annual chunks of up to $150 each — January 1 through June 30, and July 1 through December 31.
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Activate the benefit in your Chase account.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Purchase tickets through StubHub or viagogo with the Sapphire Reserve.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Jan–Jun and Jul–Dec windows; does not roll over.

benefits.name: Complimentary Apple TV
benefits.shortDescription: Complimentary Apple TV, runs through June 22, 2027
benefits.fullDescription: Complimentary Apple TV subscription — activate through the Chase app or website. Runs through June 22, 2027. Existing Apple One subscribers can instead get a $7.50/month discount on their Apple One plan (as of June 2026 — see notes).
benefits.enrollmentInstructions: Activate through the Chase app or chase.com before June 22, 2027.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Activate the complimentary Apple TV subscription; no statement credit posts — it's a comped subscription, not cash back. Apple One subscribers can instead take a $7.50/month discount on their Apple One plan (activated the same way, through the same benefits hub).
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Offer runs through June 22, 2027 — re-verify whether Chase renews or replaces it after that date. Time-boxed promotional perk, not a permanent card feature.
benefits.notes: Verified 2026-07: Chase's own stated combined value for Apple TV + Apple Music together is $288/yr, which matches this entry's $156 plus Apple Music's $132 exactly — the individual-service split was a correct estimate, now corroborated by Chase's own combined figure rather than just retail pricing math. Also updated: as of June 2026, Chase changed the Apple One clause from running as a separate parallel credit to a direct $7.50/month discount applied to the Apple One subscription itself (Apple TV's $7.50 + Apple Music's $7.50 = $15/month combined for cardholders with both active) — the earlier $8/month figure in this catalog was an approximation; $7.50 is the confirmed, precise number.

benefits.fullDescription: $120 in annual Lyft ride credits, issued as $10 per month.

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club® Visits
benefits.shortDescription: 15 visits per Medallion Year when flying Delta
benefits.fullDescription: Delta SkyMiles Reserve Card Members receive 15 visits each Medallion Year to the Delta Sky Club when flying Delta, and can unlock unlimited access after spending $75,000 in purchases on the card during a calendar year.

benefits.name: Companion Certificate
benefits.shortDescription: One round-trip companion ticket per year (taxes/fees apply)
benefits.fullDescription: Enjoy a Companion Certificate on a Delta First, Delta Comfort, or Delta Main round-trip flight within the U.S. and to Mexico, the Caribbean, or Central America each year after Card renewal.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Log in to your SkyMiles account, locate the certificate, and apply it when booking an eligible round-trip flight — must both book and complete travel by the certificate's expiration date (typically one year from issuance).
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Requires payment of government-imposed taxes and fees ($22–$250 depending on itinerary). Delta Basic fares are not eligible. One certificate per year after card renewal, not per calendar year — track relative to the card's renewal date. Certificate is transferable to someone else as a traveler.
benefits.notes: Delta's own terms state the certificate 'has no value except when redeemed' — deliberately not assigning a speculative dollar figure here, unlike some review sites that estimate $300-$1,000+ depending on cabin/route. Has its own expiration date distinct from the annual reissue date — worth surfacing both in the UI, since 'you have a new one' and 'your old one is about to expire unused' are two different reminders.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.shortDescription: Up to $120 (Global Entry) or $85 (TSA PreCheck), every 4 years
benefits.fullDescription: Receive either a statement credit up to $120 after applying for Global Entry, or a statement credit up to $85 after applying for TSA PreCheck, every 4 years.

benefits.termsAndLimitations: One reimbursement per 4-year cycle. Global Entry includes TSA PreCheck access.
benefits.notes: isMonetary: true and statusKind: 'rolling' are not a contradiction — this really is a $120 credit, but its 4-year cadence means a dollar gauge would misleadingly imply an annual reset. statusKind overrides the default ledger rendering that isMonetary: true would otherwise imply; see the BenefitStatusKind enum in §5.2.

benefits.name: Centurion® Lounge / Escape Lounge Access
benefits.shortDescription: Complimentary access when flying Delta same-day
benefits.fullDescription: U.S. Basic and Additional Delta Reserve Card Members receive complimentary access to The Centurion Lounge and Escape Lounge locations when flying on a same-day Delta-marketed or Delta-operated flight.
benefits.redemptionInstructions: Arrive within 3 hours of your departing flight (or within 5 hours of a connecting flight during a layover, effective July 8, 2026) and present your card plus boarding pass.
benefits.termsAndLimitations: Must be flying a same-day Delta-marketed or Delta-operated flight, ticketed on the Delta Reserve Card. Up to 2 guests per visit, $50/adult ($30/child 2–17) — effective July 8, 2026, every guest must be traveling on the same flight as the cardholder, not merely the same day as before. Layover access requires arriving within 5 hours of the connecting flight (also effective July 8, 2026, tightened from a more lenient prior window).
benefits.notes: Verified 2026-07: the 'recently changed' flag in this entry was correct to raise — confirmed two real rule changes effective July 8, 2026, sourced from Amex's own benefits page (CNBC Select) and cross-checked against two independent guides (Eye of the Flyer, The Points Guy) with matching dates and details: (1) layover access now requires arriving within 5 hours of the connecting flight, tightened from before, and (2) guests must now be traveling on the same flight as the cardholder, not just the same day. Both terms fields above updated to reflect this. No stated aggregate dollar value from Amex for this specific card (unlike the Personal/Business Platinum's $850 Lounge Collection framing) — track as access, not a valued ledger line.
